name: Noel Williams MD
title: Ella Ray is a SUPERSTAR TRAVEL AGENT!!!
body: We've been working on getting this trip ironed out for weeks solely because of our indecision. Ella Ray kept at... sending choice after choice till we finally decided on the winner. I can't say enough about Ella, her patience and professionalism. This will be our 3rd major overseas business class travel she has arranged in the last 2 years. She is amazing.

name: Lynda
title: Andreas Stein was knowledgeable
body: Andreas Stein was great! He was kind and patient with us as we tried to navigate the daunting task of multiple flights. The prices he found were excellent! Unfortunately, we had to cancel our trip; however, we will definitely contact Andreas again. He made it very easy to choose the flight that suited us best along with discounted prices. Thank you, Andreas

name: Viviana Raymond
title: Friendly and very patient staff
body: When I was contacted by Andreas I was extremely skeptical about the (unsolicited) flight options I was given after many hours of searching ... During the whole process Andreas was extremely friendly and patient to answer my questions. Finally I've got very good deal for the travel I was planning to purchase. I would definitely reach out to him again for my next trip.

name: Russ Gray
title: my agent Andreas Stein was very prompt…
body: my agent Andreas Stein was very prompt in responding to my inquiry. Furthermore he was very consistent with follow ups and updates and very attentive and patient in walking me through each step. He is a true asset to the firm.
